title: 第99章 有什么招，都使出来吧！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 杜凌菲知道唐逸的身份，但其他人不知道。小诗仙这个名字，炎文帝保护得很好，在京都只闻其名，不知其人。所以现在听到杜凌菲信誓旦旦的话，众人只觉得可笑，一个名不见经传的废物，竟然瞧不起三元及第的状元？是他们疯了？还是这个世界疯了。特别是姜云娜，此时脸色已经有点狰狞，唐画在她心中是完美男神，她绝不允许任何人说唐画一句不是。“你算什么东西？一个婢女，你也有资格在这里质疑画哥哥？”姜云娜抬手指着杜凌菲，冷声呵斥。杜凌菲美眸一凝，原本平静的美眸渐渐深邃起来，俏脸也渐渐变冷，整个人的气质也在渐渐发生改变。原本清新淡雅，现在渐渐冷若冰霜。抛开她自己的身世不谈，单单是贤妃身边的女官这个身份，就能轻松将姜云娜捏死。只是她还没说话，唐逸冰冷的声音已经从身后传来。“你又算什么东西？敢对我的人大呼小叫！”唐逸两步上前，将杜凌菲和唐音拉在了身后，冷眸盯着姜云娜：“手放下，再指一下，我把你的手折了！”姜云娜气得胸口起伏，一条以前跟在她后面的哈巴狗，现在竟然敢对她大呼小叫。然而，看到唐逸那没有半点情绪，深邃得宛若古井一般的眼神，她还是被镇住了，手不自觉地放了下来，杜凌菲看了一眼脸色不甘而怨毒的姜云娜，看向唐逸道：“呃，其实你不用来的，对付几个官家大小姐罢了，我和唐音能解决。”唐逸斜眸看向杜凌菲，合着我来得还不是时候呗？“注意身份，你什么身份，他们什么身份？”他瞪了杜凌菲一眼，没好气道：“为这两个愚蠢的女人，背上一个‘悍妇’的名头，不值得。”杜凌菲想了想，以她的身份的确不宜动手。毕竟她是贤妃娘娘身边的人，某种意义上来说代表的是贤妃，真动了手可能会给贤妃惹麻烦。她自己倒是无所谓，悍妇又如何？她不在意。但贤妃娘娘不行，那些御史正瞅逮不住她的小辫子呢，到时候免不了说她纵仆行凶，嚣张跋扈。她半抬的手缓缓放下，点头笑道：“好吧，你说得对。”众人听到前面的话，还以为唐逸是在训斥杜凌菲，结果听到后面才发现，原来唐逸是觉得颜霜玉和姜云娜，不值得杜凌菲动手。这让很多人看向颜霜玉和姜云娜的目光都变得诡异起来。颜霜玉是知道杜凌菲的身份的，她是贤妃身边的人，的确有看不上他们的资格。然而被唐逸众目睽睽之下这么针对，她的脸色还是挂不住。她脸上努力维持笑容，众目睽睽之下想要用长辈的身份压唐逸：“小逸，管好杜姑娘和小音，不要这么胡闹，免得……”丢了贤妃娘娘的脸！她话没说完，唐逸已经回头看来。仅仅一个眼神，颜霜玉的声音戛然而止。此时面对唐逸，那种感觉就像是面对一头猛兽一般，那种压迫感竟然让她都在心悸。“胡闹吗？不是吧？”唐逸轻笑一声，目光扫过全场：“我没觉得凌菲和音音是在开玩笑，阐述一个事实，怎么就是胡闹了？”听到这话，全场的议论声顿时都弱了下来。所有人的目光，瞬间齐刷刷地看向了唐逸。片刻，整个鹿鸣湖瞬间就沸腾起来了。“阐述一个事实？什么意思？他是说自己真比唐画厉害？”“哈哈，这牛都能吹炸天了，三元及第的状元，竟然不及他一个寂寂无名的小儿？”“无耻，他还真当自己是个人物了？”“……”无数人盯着唐逸，满脸的嘲讽和戏谑。听到这些声音，唐画满脸戏谑，唐敬一张脸都黑成了锅底。他今日来这里，是来看所有人对唐画鼓掌，是来听所有人对他恭维，是来看无数人对他羡慕嫉妒恨的！不是来看唐逸在这里吹牛的！“够了！唐逸，给我滚下去，别丢人现眼了。”唐敬站起来，冲着远处的唐逸厉声冷喝。混账东西，陛下多看你一眼，是想用你来当替身而已。你还真当陛下有多在意你？现在还敢在几百人面前大言不惭，谁给你的胆子的？没看到满场人看你的目光，就像是在看一只猴子吗？白痴！然而，唐逸只是淡淡看了他一眼，笑道：“唐侍郎，别那么着急，好戏才刚刚开始呢。”“好戏刚开始，你就想偃旗息鼓，别说你老婆和儿子不同意，我也不同意。”唐逸将唐音交给杜凌菲，看向舞台上的唐画勾了勾手：“行了，用女人嚼舌根铺垫得差不多了，有什么招，就尽管使出来吧！”“想要对付我，光明正大地来，玩阴的……我要不是不屑玩，你死都不知道怎么死。”以他前世的知识，想要悄无声息搞死唐画轻轻松松。之所以没有动手，是他不屑于用这种手段。唐画瞳孔微微一缩，没想到唐逸竟然众目睽睽之下点他。他原本想利用颜霜玉和姜云娜先造势，让唐逸成为众矢之的，失去参与沈园诗会的资格。只要唐逸失去参与沈园诗会的资格，那他殿试抄袭诗词的事，便不会有人知晓了。结果，现在唐逸却直截了当地找了他。也罢，既然你想正面玩，那我便陪你正面玩吧……唐画仰起头，唇角笑容有些无奈：“四弟，非要闹到这一步吗？有些事为兄给你留了面子，真闹大了，你以后还如何在京都立足呢？”“听大哥一句劝，离开吧，别再胡闹了！”唐逸眼眸眯起，被恶心到了，这家伙还真不愧是伪君子中的伪君子。明明就是他设计要害人，结果愣是摆出了一副我是为你好的样子。“这句话，留给你自己吧！”“还有什么招，使出来，我接着。”唐逸冷笑盯着唐画，他倒是要看看，这家伙铺垫这么久，到底想要干什么。倒是希望能有点新意！
content_en: Du Lingfei knew Tang Yi's identity, but others did not.Emperor Yanwen protected the name Xiao Shixian very well. People in Kyoto only heard of his name but did not know his name.So now when they heard Du Lingfei's vows, everyone just thought it was ridiculous that a little-known waste actually looked down on the number one scholar who got three yuan?Are they crazy?The world is still crazy.Jiang Yunna, in particular, looked a little ferocious at this time. Tang Hua was the perfect male god in her heart, and she would never allow anyone to say anything wrong about Tang Hua."Who do you think you are? As a maid, do you have the right to question Brother Hua here?" Jiang Yunna pointed at Du Lingfei and scolded her coldly.Du Lingfei's beautiful eyes condensed, and her originally calm beautiful eyes gradually became darker, her pretty face gradually became colder, and her whole temperament gradually changed.It was originally fresh and elegant, but now it is gradually becoming as cold as ice.Regardless of her own life experience, Jiang Yunna could be easily crushed to death just by being the female official next to Concubine Xian.But before she could speak, Tang Yi's cold voice came from behind."Who do you think you are? You dare to yell at my people!" Tang Yi stepped forward, pulled Du Lingfei and Tang Yin behind him, and stared at Jiang Yunna with cold eyes: "Put your hand down, point again, and I will break your hand!" Jiang Yunna's chest heaved with anger. A pug that used to follow her now dared to yell at her.However, seeing Tang Yi's emotionless eyes, which were as deep as an ancient well, she was still calmed down, and she lowered her hands unconsciously. Du Lingfei glanced at Jiang Yunna, who looked unwilling and resentful, and looked at Tang Yi and said: "Well, actually you don't have to come here. It's just to deal with a few official ladies. Tang Yin and I can handle it." Tang Yi looked sideways at Du Lingfei, isn't it the right time to come with me?"Pay attention to your identity, what is your identity, and what are their identities?" He glared at Du Lingfei and said angrily: "It's not worth carrying the name of a 'shrew' for these two stupid women." Du Lingfei thought about it, and it was really not appropriate to take action based on her identity.After all, she is the person close to the Concubine Xian, and in a sense, she represents the Concubine Xian. If she really takes action, she may cause trouble for the Concubine Xian.It doesn't matter to her, but what about the shrew?She doesn't care.But the Concubine Xian couldn't do it. Those censors couldn't catch her pigtails, and they would inevitably say that she was arrogant and domineering.She slowly lowered her half-raised hand, nodded and smiled, "Okay, you're right." When everyone heard the previous words, they thought Tang Yi was reprimanding Du Lingfei, but after hearing the latter, they discovered that Tang Yi felt that Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna were not worthy of Du Lingfei's action.This made many people look at Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna strangely.Yan Shuangyu knew Du Lingfei's identity. She was someone close to Concubine Xian, and she was indeed qualified to look down on them.However, being targeted by Tang Yi in full view of everyone, she still couldn't stand it.She tried hard to maintain a smile on her face, trying to use her status as an elder to suppress Tang Yi in front of everyone: "Xiaoyi, take care of Miss Du and Xiaoyin, don't act like this, lest..." You will lose the face of Concubine Xian!Before she finished speaking, Tang Yi had already looked back.With just one look, Yan Shuangyu's voice stopped abruptly.Facing Tang Yi at this time, it felt like facing a ferocious beast, and the sense of oppression actually made her heart palpitate."Is it nonsense? Isn't it?" Tang Yi chuckled and glanced across the audience: "I don't think Ling Fei and Yinyin are joking. They are stating a fact. Why is it nonsense?" Upon hearing this, the discussion in the audience suddenly weakened.Everyone's eyes immediately turned to Tang Yi.In a moment, the entire Luming Lake was boiling."State a fact? What do you mean? He is saying that he is really better than Tang Hua?" "Haha, this guy can boast to the sky. The number one scholar with three yuan is actually inferior to this unknown kid?" "Shameless, does he really think he is a person?" "..." Countless people stared at Tang Yi, with ridicule and teasing on their faces.Hearing these voices, Tang Hua's face was full of joking, and Tang Jing's face turned black.He came here today to see everyone applaud Tang Hua, to hear everyone compliment him, and to see countless people envy and hate him!I’m not here to see Tang Yi bragging!"That's enough! Tang Yi, get out of here, don't be embarrassed." Tang Jing stood up and shouted sternly at Tang Yi in the distance.You bastard, His Majesty is looking at you just because he wants to use you as a substitute.Do you really think His Majesty cares about you?Now you dare to talk so brazenly in front of hundreds of people, who gave you the courage?Didn’t you see that the whole place looked at you as if they were looking at a monkey?idiot!However, Tang Yi just glanced at him and said with a smile: "Tang Shilang, don't be so anxious, the show has just begun." "You want to stop the show just as it begins, not to mention that your wife and son don't agree, I don't agree either." Tang Yi handed Tang Yin to Du Lingfei, looked at Tang Hua on the stage and hookedHand: "Okay, you've laid the groundwork with women's talk. If you have any tricks, just use them!" "If you want to deal with me, do it openly and play dirty... If I didn't disdain to play, you wouldn't know how to die." With the knowledge of his previous life, it would be easy to kill Tang Hua quietly.The reason why he didn't take action was that he didn't bother to use this method.Tang Hua's pupils shrank slightly, but he didn't expect Tang Yi to click on him in full view of everyone.He originally wanted to use Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna to build momentum first, making Tang Yi the target of public criticism and disqualifying him from participating in the Shenyuan Poetry Society.As long as Tang Yi loses the qualification to participate in the Shenyuan Poetry Society, no one will know about his plagiarizing poems in the imperial examination.As a result, Tang Yi now came to him directly.Forget it, since you want to play it head-on, then I will play it head-on with you... Tang Hua raised his head, with a helpless smile on his lips: "Fourth brother, do you have to go to this point? Some things have saved you face for my brother. If it is really big, how can you gain a foothold in Kyoto in the future?" "Listen to the elder brother's advice, leave and stop messing around!" Tang Yi narrowed his eyes and was disgusted. This guy is truly the hypocrite among hypocrites.It was obvious that he was planning to harm people, but in the end he acted like I was doing it for your own good."Keep this sentence to yourself!" "If you have any other moves, use them and I'll take over." Tang Yi sneered and stared at Tang Hua. He wanted to see what this guy wanted to do after laying the groundwork for so long.
title_en: Chapter 99 Use whatever tricks you have!
